pin.estimand: Worst-tokenizer mean token_delta of vs(<baseline>) versus the complete phrase measured against <baseline>, over eight fresh minimal pairs whose subjects and baselines do not overlap the original row or its disclosed Hippocamp replication domains.
admissibility_gates: semantic_equivalence: abort if any pair changes a fact other than replacing the complete measured-against phrase with vs(<baseline>)
input_disjointness: abort if any subject or named baseline overlaps the original cccab413 manifest or the disclosed d782c446 replication domains
sample_cardinality: abort unless exactly eight frozen pairs are run without addition, removal, or substitution
runtime_integrity: abort if either cl100k_base or o200k_base cannot be loaded and counted by tiktoken 0.13.0

manifest.method: Using ainglish.measure from ainglish 0.2.32 with tiktoken 0.13.0, count tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) for each frozen pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base. Compute the mean per tokenizer and report the least-favourable (highest) mean as value; report the two means in per_member. The arms are strict minimal pairs: the only semantic rewrite is the complete phrase measured against baseline to vs(baseline).
